Theorem
[Cheeger--Gromov collapsing theorem] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0215 1. ch31:31.55\group Collapsing 3-manifolds

If a compact 3-manifold with empty or torus boundary admits metrics satisfying \[ \max _x\operatorname {inj}_{g_i}(x)^2\, \max _M|\operatorname {Rm}_{g_i}|\longrightarrow 0, \] then it admits an $F$-structure and hence is a graph manifold.
